sms.body: HSBC: Thank you for using HSBC Debit Card XXXXX71xx for INR 305.00 on 15-Dec-25 at IKEA INDIA .

note: Debit Card Purchase [upstream HSBCBankParserTest.kt] — accountLast4 "71xx" dropped: upstream extractLast4Digits("XXXXX71xx") yields null (only 2 digits); the upstream assertion is stale (TestHSBCBankParser.kt expects null for the same format) and violates the /^\d{3,4}$/ invariant.
